description: Case B on the WCI emulator, completed: two lifetimes, one Build ID.

scenarios.title: Case A: $40 headphones, auto-approved
scenarios.summary: Support's agents look up the order, then ask Finance over Nexus. Under $100 and low risk, Finance approves on its own.

preconditions.label: A Support worker or the AgentCore app is up

steps.title: Start Case A
steps.talk: A customer's headphones arrived broken. They want their money back.

steps.title: Support reads Finance's Agent Card
steps.talk: Support discovers what Finance offers: one published card, nothing else.

steps.title: Support asks Finance over Nexus
steps.talk: Support can't move money, so it asks Finance, another team's agent.

steps.title: Finance approves on its own
steps.talk: Forty dollars and low risk: Finance's policy approves without a human.

steps.title: Support replies with the refund ID
steps.talk: The reply quotes the refund ID that Finance's payment call returned.

scenarios.notes: Support can't move money, so it asks Finance: a different team's agent, through a published contract and a named endpoint. It isn't a child workflow and the workers never talk to each other.

scenarios.title: Case B: $450 laptop, a human approves
scenarios.summary: Over $100, Finance's agent asks a person. Support can be stopped while Finance waits, and nothing is lost.

preconditions.label: A Support worker or the AgentCore app is up

steps.title: Start Case B
steps.talk: A customer asks for $450 back on a laptop.

steps.title: Finance asks a human
steps.talk: Over $100, Finance's agent says 'I need a human'.

steps.title: Stop the Support worker (optional)
steps.talk: I stop Support's worker. Finance is still waiting, and nothing is lost.

steps.title: Approve the refund
steps.talk: I approve as dana.finance.

steps.title: Start the Support worker again
steps.talk: A fresh worker replays the history and carries on.

steps.title: Support replies with the refund ID
steps.talk: The reply quotes Finance's refund ID.

scenarios.notes: Over $100, Finance's agent says 'I need a human', and the task goes to input-required. The conversation waits in history, not in memory.

scenarios.title: Durable agent: kill the worker mid-thought
scenarios.summary: Kill Support's worker while a model call is in flight, start it again, and the same run finishes.

steps.title: Start Case A
steps.talk: Every model call and tool call is an Activity.

steps.title: Kill the Support worker mid-thought
steps.talk: I kill the process while the model is thinking.

steps.title: Start it again
steps.talk: A new process picks up the same run from history.

steps.title: The same run finishes
steps.talk: It carried on from exactly where it stopped.

scenarios.notes: Every model call and tool call is an Activity. I kill the process mid-thought, and it carries on from exactly where it stopped.

scenarios.title: Case B, AgentCore shape, invoke-local
scenarios.summary: You start each AgentCore lifetime by hand. Between them, Support has no compute at all.

steps.title: Invoke the AgentCore app (lifetime 1)
steps.talk: I play the server's part and invoke the app.

steps.title: Start Case B on support-tq
steps.talk: A customer asks for $450 back on a laptop.

steps.title: Finance asks a human
steps.talk: Over $100, Finance's agent asks a person.

steps.title: Support's compute drains
steps.talk: Twenty seconds idle, and the worker is gone.

steps.title: Approve the refund
steps.talk: I approve as dana.finance.

steps.title: Invoke the app again (lifetime 2)
steps.talk: A new lifetime picks up the reply.

steps.title: Support replies with the refund ID
steps.talk: Same build, pinned.

scenarios.notes: Support's Worker is now built to die. It starts when invoked, works, idles for the debounce and drains.

scenarios.title: Case B, the server's WCI starts the worker
scenarios.summary: Finance waits for a human while Support's compute is gone; the server restarts it.

preconditions.label: Dev server runs with the WCI (WCI=1)
support-supervisor:4ee7f87 is current with local WCI compute

steps.title: Start Case B on support-tq
steps.talk: A customer asks for $450 back on a laptop.

steps.title: The WCI starts lifetime 1
steps.talk: Nothing was polling. The server's Worker Controller invoked AgentCore.

steps.title: Finance asks a human
steps.talk: Over $100, Finance's agent says 'I need a human'.

steps.title: Support's compute drains
steps.talk: Support's worker is gone. Nothing runs and nothing is billed.

steps.title: Approve the refund
steps.talk: I approve as dana.finance.

steps.title: The WCI starts lifetime 2
steps.talk: Finance's answer landed in Support's history, so the server starts a worker.

steps.title: Support replies with the refund ID
steps.talk: Same build, pinned: support-supervisor:4ee7f87.

steps.title: Read the report
steps.talk: Two lifetimes, one Build ID, reply seconds after the approval.

scenarios.notes: Finance is waiting for a human, and Support's compute is gone. Nothing runs and nothing is billed, but the conversation is still there. I approve, and Temporal starts a fresh worker to finish the reply.

scenarios.title: Case B on AgentCore in AWS
scenarios.summary: The real thing: Support on AgentCore Runtime, the WCI on EKS, two sessions around a human approval.

steps.title: Resume the AWS stack
steps.talk: The stack was paused overnight.

steps.title: Start Case B on support-tq
steps.talk: A customer asks for $450 back on a laptop.

steps.title: Finance asks a human
steps.talk: Finance's agent on EKS asks a person.

steps.title: Support's session drains (estimated)
steps.talk: The AgentCore session ends. Nothing is billed.

steps.title: Approve the refund
steps.talk: I approve as dana.finance.

steps.title: The WCI starts session 2
steps.talk: The Nexus completion makes the WCI invoke AgentCore again.

steps.title: Support replies with the refund ID
steps.talk: Same build, pinned.

scenarios.notes: Finance is waiting for a human, and Support's compute is gone. Nothing runs and nothing is billed.

scenarios.title: Finance disappears mid-call
scenarios.summary: Stop the Finance worker after discovery. The Nexus call retries on the server until Finance comes back.

preconditions.label: A Support worker or the AgentCore app is up

steps.title: Start Case A
steps.talk: Same Case A as before.

steps.title: Support reads Finance's Agent Card
steps.talk: Discovery worked: Finance is there.

steps.title: Stop the Finance worker
steps.talk: Now Finance's team has an outage.

steps.title: The Nexus call retries
steps.talk: Support's call doesn't fail. The server retries it, attempt after attempt.

steps.title: Start the Finance worker
steps.talk: Finance comes back.

steps.title: The run completes
steps.talk: The same call completes. No code handled the outage.

scenarios.notes: Finance disappears. Support's call is held by the server and retried; when Finance comes back, the same call completes.

scenarios.title: The hop with no AI
scenarios.summary: A plain workflow calls Finance over Nexus, then fetches the Agent Card.

steps.title: Run the smoke caller
steps.talk: No AI on the caller, just the hop.

steps.title: Fetch the Agent Card
steps.talk: The one thing Finance publishes.

scenarios.notes: The Finance team publishes exactly one thing, an A2A-shaped contract.

scenarios.title: N conversations at once
scenarios.summary: Start up to 20 runs on support-tq and count the WCI's invokes.

steps.title: Start the batch
steps.talk: Ten conversations at once, on the same version.

scenarios.notes: Scale out is the same mechanism: the WCI invokes as many lifetimes as there is work.

scenarios.title: Leftovers
scenarios.summary: Runs still waiting for a human. Reject or terminate them.
